caption: The switch on a battery pack attached to a garland of lights is slid on, and the garland lights up.

sa.check: A garland of small lights with a battery pack attached to it.
The switch on the battery pack is slid to its on position.
The garland is dark before the switch is slid.
The order is dark, slide, lit.

pc.expect: The bulbs come on at the moment the switch slides across, and only then.
pc.fail: The switch is slid and the garland stays dark; or the bulbs are lit before the switch moves; or the garland lights up while the switch sits untouched.

pc.expect: The lit bulbs are the same bulbs seen dark: the same number at the same spots along the wire, and the whole string comes on together.
pc.fail: Lit points appear along the wire where no bulb hung before; or bulbs seen on the dark string are gone once lit; or lit bulbs multiply or shift along the wire; or the bulbs come on one after another from one end rather than together.

pc.expect: Once on, the garland stays lit while the switch stays in its on position, and the glow sits at the bulbs.
pc.fail: The garland goes dark again with the switch untouched; or the switch slides back by itself; or the glow spreads onto the bare wire between the bulbs.

pc.expect: Sliding the switch moves only the switch: the pack, wire and garland stay where they lie apart from a small nudge.
pc.fail: The garland jumps or rearranges as the switch is slid; or the pack slides away with nothing touching it; or the wire lifts off the surface by itself.

pc.expect: The pack keeps its box shape, the garland stays one continuous wire and fingers stay outside the pack.
pc.fail: The pack changes shape or turns into another object; or the string splits in two or fuses with itself; or fingers pass through the pack; or the pack vanishes.

pc.expect: The wire's colour, the pack's markings and the background stay the same apart from the light.
pc.fail: The wire changes colour; or the pack's markings change; or the background rearranges.
